Four percent, and who has to hear about it before Friday.
Issue 62 · 3 September 2026

Four percent, and everyone downstream

6 minute read · by Amara Osei

What actually moved

The reconciliation closed on Tuesday and lifted the September line by 4.1 percent. That is inside the tolerance the board agreed in June, which is exactly why nobody flagged it — and exactly why three teams are still quoting the old figure.

Who has to be told

Field operations, the vendor desk, and whoever owns the Q4 template. In that order, and before Friday.
